data.text: Plan: create a routed first-draft PCB and LAYOUT.md, preserving the 30 × 20 mm, two-layer, 3.3 V, current, RF impedance, antenna-keepout, and footprint-rotation constraints. Risk is concentrated in RF geometry/keepout, connector edge placement, decoupling proximity, and achieving zero DRC/unconnected items; the draft-quality section will explicitly flag specialist RF/layout rework.

args.why: Create the required first-draft physical implementation with constraint-driven placement, complete routing, and explicit documentation of draft limitations.
args.what_changes:
- Place all footprints at real coordinates within the existing board outline, with J1 on an edge, U1 support parts at their pins, the RF chain and antenna aligned to an edge, and antenna keepouts honored.
- Rotate long footprints onto a board axis where required, accounting for rotated footprint extents.
- Route every electrical net on the two-layer board, including the 50-ohm RF feed as a documented draft geometry, until DRC reports no unconnected items.
- Add or update docs/LAYOUT.md with a `## Draft quality` section stating exactly what is acceptable and what requires human or specialist-tool rework.
- Update design documentation and changelog for every placement, routing, keepout, and intentional protection decision.
args.tasks:
- [ ] Inspect the existing board, schematic, footprints, nets, outline, and layout documentation.
- [ ] Place connectors, U1, decoupling, crystal, RF components, antenna, and test points by rule.
- [ ] Add/verify antenna copper keepout and route every electrical net.
- [ ] Document first-draft quality and any intentionally absent connector protection.
- [ ] Run DRC and resolve all violations and unconnected items.
- [ ] Run ERC, schematic legibility check if schematic changes, drift check, and update decision/constraint records and changelog.
- [ ] Export the PCB render and finish only after all gates pass.

# Layout

The board uses the existing 30 mm × 20 mm, two-layer, 1.6 mm FR-4 outline. J1 belongs on a board edge and must be rotated onto the 30 mm axis because its 23.86 mm courtyard does not fit the 20 mm axis. U1, its supply bypass capacitors, AVDD bead, reset bias, and crystal network belong in the central non-antenna region with the shortest practical return paths. The differential RF chain U1–C11/C12–B1 and the single-ended matching chain B1–L1/C9–L2/C10–AE1 must remain compact and monotonic toward the antenna edge.
